sources.excerpt: CLHD EVR Manual – Leqtiqueshop Skip to content Submit Close search Leqtiqueshop Submit Search Log in Cart CLHD EVR Manual This is the manual page for Leqtique EVR -CLHD EVR. This pedal shares many of its sound and features with the Leqtique - CLHD, designed in 2014. For an explanation of each control, please refer to the original manual below. However, the EVR version has a small Low-Cut control between Volume and Definition. On a regular CLHD, this Low-Cut is turned all the way to the left (no low-cut), but if you want a sharper cut or if your playing environment has too much low end, turning this control clockwise will lighten the sound and be beneficial. In addition, the original CLHD had a vulnerability in the internal boost IC, which meant that repeatedly plugging and unplugging the power supply without the input jack plugged in would damage the IC and prevent it from operating. However, the CLHD EVR's internal boost circuit has been strengthened along with a change to the IC, so no matter how you plug and unplug the jack or turn it on and off, there are no problems. Just like the original, the voltage is boosted internally to 30V for operation. Input Voltage: 9V (10-18V cannot be used) Current Consumption: 37 (mA) (DC power supply is recommended as batteries consume too much power) Privacy Policy Legal Credits © 2026, Leqtiqueshop Powered by Shopify
